title: Inspect project capabilities before selecting work
actor: An engineer joining an existing project
goal: Understand available operations and local store standing without receiving an inferred Change or authority.
context: The engineer has project access but has not selected a change or authorized a workflow transition. A fresh checkout may contain the engineering definition without its local operational history.

interaction.action: Requests actual operation and contract availability for the project.
Reports supported tasks and backend standing without scanning historical directories or choosing work.
Uses the Change identifier supplied by the handoff or request to inspect that work explicitly.

expected_outcome: The engineer distinguishes executable availability, backend readiness and actor-selected work without automatic activation or approval.

alternatives.outcome: Read its current context directly under explicit selection.

failures.condition: The backend is absent, mismatched, unsupported, corrupt or fenced.
failures.outcome: Report that standing without creating a store or presenting unavailable history as an empty valid selection.
